strings.zh: 哎？奇怪了,{NEWLINE}上船之前明明有采购盐的啊！{CLEAR}这下晚宴的菜可怎么做啊。
strings.en: Huh? That’s strange. I’m sure I bought{NEWLINE}salt before we boarded!{SCROLL}How am I supposed to cook the dinner{NEWLINE}now?

strings.zh: 嗯？你是来……{SCROLL}哦,你想要蜂蜜啊。{SCROLL}蜂蜜是还有的,{NEWLINE}不过这都是花钱采购的食材……
strings.en: Hm? You’re here for...{SCROLL}Oh, you want honey.{SCROLL}We do still have honey, but it’s all{NEWLINE}ingredients we paid good money for...

strings.zh: 有了！{SCROLL}你看起来很有办法的样子,{NEWLINE}如果你能给我弄来盐的话{CLEAR}我就可以送你一些蜂蜜。
strings.en: I know!{SCROLL}You look like someone who can get things{NEWLINE}done. If you can bring me some salt,{CLEAR}I’ll give you some honey.

strings.zh: 啊哈！{NEWLINE}你身上带的不就是浅水盐吗？{CLEAR}可以把他送给我吗？{CLEAR}我用蜂蜜跟你交换！
strings.en: Aha! Isn’t that Shoal Salt you’ve got{NEWLINE}there?{SCROLL}Could you give it to me? I’ll trade you{NEWLINE}honey for it!

strings.zh: 我真的很需要盐,{NEWLINE}如果你什么时候想跟我交换了{CLEAR}随时可以来找我！
strings.en: I really need salt. Whenever you want{NEWLINE}to trade, come see me anytime!

strings.zh: 谢谢！{NEWLINE}你可真是帮了我的大忙！{SCROLL}这罐蜂蜜送给你！
strings.en: Thanks! You’re a real lifesaver!{SCROLL}This jar of Honey is yours!

strings.zh: 熊宝宝『Teddi！{SCROLL}熊宝宝很开心地吃着冰箱里的蜂蜜。
strings.en: Teddiursa: Teddi!{SCROLL}Teddiursa is happily eating the honey{NEWLINE}from the fridge.

strings.zh: 熊宝宝『Teddi！
strings.en: Teddiursa: Teddi!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『吃饱了咱就回去吧,{NEWLINE}你的主人正在担心你呢。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Now that you’ve eaten, let’s{NEWLINE}go back. Your owner is worried about{CLEAR}you.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『真是个贪吃的孩子,{NEWLINE}如果吃饱了就快回去吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: What a greedy little guy. If{NEWLINE}you’re full, hurry on back.

strings.zh: 船员们正在休息,{NEWLINE}请不要打扰到他们。{CLEAR}客人您还是回大厅参加派对吧。
strings.en: The crew is resting. Please don’t{NEWLINE}disturb them.{SCROLL}Please go back to the main hall and{NEWLINE}enjoy the party.

strings.zh: 前面是船长室,{NEWLINE}船长正在休息,{CLEAR}请不要过去打扰他。
strings.en: The captain’s cabin is ahead. The{NEWLINE}captain is resting, so please don’t go{CLEAR}bother him.

strings.zh: 喂！刚刚上面的声音很嘈杂,{NEWLINE}是不是发生什么事了？
strings.en: Hey! It got really noisy upstairs just{NEWLINE}now. Did something happen?

strings.zh: 没有没有,是您多虑了。
strings.en: No, no, you’re worrying over nothing.

strings.zh: 你别骗我！绝对是出什么事了。{SCROLL}赶紧让开,我要去见船长。
strings.en: Don’t lie to me! Something definitely{NEWLINE}happened.{SCROLL}Out of the way. I’m going to see the{NEWLINE}captain.

strings.zh: 您真的多心了,{NEWLINE}并没有任何事情发生。{CLEAR}可能就是派对太欢乐太吵了而已。{CLEAR}既然船长让各位在这里安心休息,{CLEAR}那就请各位严格执行船长的命令吧。
strings.en: Really, you’re overthinking it. Nothing{NEWLINE}has happened. The party’s probably{CLEAR}just loud and rowdy.{SCROLL}The captain told you all to rest here,{NEWLINE}so please follow the captain’s orders.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『现在船上有火箭队,{NEWLINE}这个犯罪团伙非常危险,{CLEAR}请让我去见船长说明情况。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Team Rocket is on this ship.{NEWLINE}They’re a very dangerous gang.{SCROLL}Please let me see the captain and{NEWLINE}explain.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我越看你越可疑,{NEWLINE}这里这么多火箭队,{CLEAR}你怎么跟没事人似的！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: The more I look at you, the{NEWLINE}more suspicious you seem.{SCROLL}Team Rocket’s all over the place, and{NEWLINE}you’re acting like nothing’s wrong!

strings.zh: 火箭队有什么危险的,{NEWLINE}我看破坏我们火箭队计划的你{CLEAR}才是最危险的吧！
strings.en: What’s so dangerous about Team{NEWLINE}Rocket? I’d say you, the one wrecking{CLEAR}Team Rocket’s plans, are the real{CLEAR}danger!

strings.zh: 哈哈哈哈,因为我就是火箭队啊！
strings.en: Hahahaha! Because I AM Team Rocket!

strings.zh: 嗯,安在这里{NEWLINE}从侧面冲击螺旋桨轴的话……
strings.en: Hmm, if I put it here, it’ll hit the{NEWLINE}propeller shaft from the side...

strings.zh: 啊哈哈,没什么,{NEWLINE}我在对游轮的发动机进行检修。
strings.en: Ah ha ha, it’s nothing. I’m just doing{NEWLINE}maintenance on the ship’s engine.

strings.zh: 刚装好的炸弹被发现了么？{SCROLL}没办法,只能先让你闭嘴了！
strings.en: You found the bomb I just planted?{SCROLL}No choice, then. I’ll have to shut you{NEWLINE}up first!

strings.zh: 我投降,我投降！{NEWLINE}我把炸弹拿掉就是了。
strings.en: I give up, I give up! I’ll take the bomb{NEWLINE}off!

strings.zh: 炸弹安装失败的事{NEWLINE}要是让水吾桐大人知道可就惨了。
strings.en: If Master Archie finds out I failed to{NEWLINE}plant the bomb, I’m done for.

strings.zh: 你竟然敢独自跑到这里,{NEWLINE}这次我可不会再输给你了！
strings.en: You came here all alone? This time I{NEWLINE}won’t lose to you!

strings.zh: 拿了新的精灵都打不赢你么。
strings.en: Even with new Pokémon, I still can’t{NEWLINE}beat you?

strings.zh: 虽然我不是你的对手,{NEWLINE}但是你也不是水吾桐大人的对手。
strings.en: I’m no match for you, but you’re no{NEWLINE}match for Master Archie either.

strings.zh: 不能再让你往前一步！
strings.en: You’re not taking one more step!

strings.zh: 吃不成大餐了……
strings.en: There goes my feast...

strings.zh: 加入火箭队{NEWLINE}就可以随心所欲地吃大餐了！
strings.en: Join Team Rocket, and you can feast{NEWLINE}whenever you want!

strings.zh: 哼,神气什么,{NEWLINE}你就等着圣安努号沉没吧。
strings.en: Hmph. Go ahead and gloat. Just wait till{NEWLINE}the S.S. Anne sinks.

strings.zh: 臭小鬼,{NEWLINE}再让你见识一下姐姐的厉害！
strings.en: Brat, let me show you again what this{NEWLINE}big sister can do!

strings.zh: 您好,这里是船员们的休息室。
strings.en: Hello, this is the crew’s rest room.

strings.zh: 唔……{NEWLINE}昨晚陪副船长和二副喝了一宿{CLEAR}让我再多睡会儿。
strings.en: Urgh... I was up all night drinking with{NEWLINE}the first mate and the second mate.{SCROLL}Let me sleep a little longer.

strings.zh: 您好,这里是圣安努号的厨房。{SCROLL}厨师和服务员们正在里面{NEWLINE}为派对的餐点做最后准备。
strings.en: Hello, this is the S.S. Anne’s kitchen.{SCROLL}The cooks and waiters are inside making{NEWLINE}the final preparations for the party{CLEAR}food.

strings.zh: 乘客您好,{NEWLINE}这次派对的食物绝对会给您{CLEAR}一•个•惊•喜•的！
strings.en: Dear passenger, the food at this party{NEWLINE}is sure to be... a... big... surprise!

strings.zh: 不愧是票价高昂的豪华游轮,{NEWLINE}这里食物还真是好吃啊。
strings.en: Just what you’d expect from a luxury{NEWLINE}liner with such pricey tickets. The food{CLEAR}here is delicious.

strings.zh: 多吃点、多吃点,{NEWLINE}一会儿可是有重大工作呢。
strings.en: Eat up, eat up. We’ve got a big job{NEWLINE}later.

strings.zh: 喵喵『好久没……
strings.en: Meowth: Been ages since...

strings.zh: 喵喵『Meow！
strings.en: Meowth: Meow!

strings.zh: 从动力室的梯子上去就是船长室了,{NEWLINE}游轮航行的操控都是在那进行的。
strings.en: Go up the ladder in the engine room, and{NEWLINE}you’ll reach the captain’s cabin. That’s{CLEAR}where the ship is steered.

strings.zh: 嘿嘿嘿,只要有水吾桐大人在{NEWLINE}你们就没有胜算！
strings.en: Heh heh heh, as long as Master Archie’s{NEWLINE}here, you don’t stand a chance!

strings.zh: 只要有了这个浅水盐,{NEWLINE}就一定能做出美味的菜！
strings.en: With this Shoal Salt, I can definitely{NEWLINE}make some delicious dishes!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『现在可不是休息的时候,{NEWLINE}派对上出现了企图劫持游轮的火箭队,{CLEAR}船长可能已经被人控制了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: This is no time to rest! Team{NEWLINE}Rocket showed up at the party to hijack{CLEAR}the ship.{SCROLL}The captain may already be in their{NEWLINE}hands!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这么大动静你说没事？{NEWLINE}你干嘛阻止水手不让他们出来？{CLEAR}我看你跟火箭队是一伙的吧？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: All this commotion and you say{NEWLINE}it’s nothing? Why are you keeping the{CLEAR}sailors in here?{SCROLL}I bet you’re working with Team Rocket!

strings.zh: 切,你就是那个{NEWLINE}破坏我们派对行动的小鬼吧。{CLEAR}又跑来我这碍事,{CLEAR}真是活得不耐烦了。
strings.en: Tch. You’re that brat who wrecked our{NEWLINE}party operation.{SCROLL}Getting in my way again? You must be{NEWLINE}tired of living.

strings.zh: 居然想破坏我们火箭队的行动,{NEWLINE}你真是太不自量力了！
strings.en: Trying to wreck Team Rocket’s{NEWLINE}operation? You’re way out of{CLEAR}your league!
strings.notes: | RV052: meaning: 不自量力 = overestimating yourself, not ‘knowing your place’

strings.zh: 多谢你来揭穿火箭队的阴谋。{SCROLL}我们的口袋妖怪都被收走了,{NEWLINE}暂时没法跟火箭队战斗,{CLEAR}所以拜托你先去救出船长吧,拜托了！
strings.en: Thanks for exposing Team Rocket’s plot.{SCROLL}They took all our Pokémon, so we can’t{NEWLINE}fight Team Rocket right now.{SCROLL}Please go rescue the captain first.{NEWLINE}We’re counting on you!

strings.zh: 我试吃了一下特制的精灵食品,{NEWLINE}结果头晕脑胀的……
strings.en: I tasted the special Pokémon food, and{NEWLINE}now my head is spinning...

strings.zh: 太可恶了,火箭队居然{NEWLINE}设下了这么大一个局,{CLEAR}把我们都给坑进去了！
strings.en: Unforgivable! Team Rocket set up this{NEWLINE}whole trap, and we all walked right into{CLEAR}it!

strings.zh: 大丈夫生于天地间,{NEWLINE}岂能郁郁久居人下。{CLEAR}老子整天伺候那个糟老头子船长{CLEAR}早他妈受够了！
strings.en: A real man isn’t born to spend his life{NEWLINE}under someone else’s thumb!{SCROLL}Serving that crusty old captain all{NEWLINE}day... I’m fucking sick of it!
strings.notes: zh 老子…早他妈受够了 kept at strength.

strings.zh: 我正在享受船长专属的美食呢,{NEWLINE}别来打扰我！
strings.en: I’m enjoying the captain’s personal{NEWLINE}gourmet meal. Don’t bother me!

strings.zh: 我昨晚值夜班了,{NEWLINE}让我再多睡会儿……
strings.en: I was on night watch last night. Let me{NEWLINE}sleep a little longer...

strings.zh: 饮食是旅行途中的重要体验,{NEWLINE}我要尽力为游客们做到最好才行。
strings.en: Food is a big part of any trip. I have to{NEWLINE}do my very best for our passengers.

strings.zh: 您好客人,这里是游轮的厨房,{NEWLINE}请您在参观的时候注意卫生。
strings.en: Hello, this is the ship’s kitchen. Please{NEWLINE}keep things clean while you look around.

strings.zh: 这里是船员们休息的地方,{NEWLINE}请您在参观的时候放低声音。
strings.en: This is where the crew rests. Please{NEWLINE}keep your voice down while you look{CLEAR}around.

strings.zh: 这里是动力室,到处都是精密仪器,{NEWLINE}你可不要乱动啊。
strings.en: This is the engine room. There’s{NEWLINE}precision equipment everywhere, so{CLEAR}don’t touch anything.

strings.zh: 我都已经被你给打败了,{NEWLINE}你还缠着我干嘛？{CLEAR}怎么,想跟我再干一架吗？
strings.en: You already beat me. Why are you still{NEWLINE}hanging around me? What, want another{CLEAR}fight?

strings.zh: 不想干架的话就该干嘛干嘛去,{NEWLINE}别打扰我享用美食。
strings.en: If you don’t want a fight, go do your{NEWLINE}own thing and let me enjoy my meal.

strings.zh: 哼,虽然我打不过你,{NEWLINE}但我不怕你！
strings.en: Hmph. I can’t beat you, but I’m not{NEWLINE}scared of you!

strings.zh: 好吧,又是你赢了。{NEWLINE}你现在该干嘛干嘛去吧,{CLEAR}别再打扰我享用美食了！
strings.en: Fine, you win again. Now go do your own{NEWLINE}thing and stop interrupting my meal!
